flashcard_questions.q: A sequence of single notes that form a recognisable musical line or tune.
Melodic movement by step, where notes move to the next note up or down in the scale.
Melodic movement by leap, where notes jump over one or more scale degrees.

flashcard_questions.a: A musical scale with five notes per octave, most commonly notes 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 of the major scale.
Extra notes added to a melody for decoration; they are not essential to the main tune.
